title: Document evaluate's shared one-minute deadline and its busy refusals in shipped and feature docs
outcome: Document evaluate's shared one-minute deadline and its busy refusals in shipped and feature docs
acceptance: docs/shipped.md and docs/features/acceptance-evaluation.md state that an evaluate submission's waits (store opens, the shared connection, source reads and the writer) share one deadline of at least one minute; that no write begins and nothing commits after it, the refusal being a busy store that records nothing; and that an exact resend owing nothing answers from a read
